about: A tool that exits short of a verdict is reported with its exit code and its reason. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE jpcheck/common.py tests/test_check_exit_codes.py tests/mutants/jpt-tool-result-on-common.json

mutants.name: the note is dropped
mutants.target: mypy that cannot run: the note names the plugin mypy could not load

mutants.name: the note reads stdout before stderr
mutants.target: a crash with output on both streams: the note is stderr's

mutants.name: the note is the last line, even a hint
edits: why = next((ln for ln in reversed(said) if "error" in ln.lower()), said[-1] if said else "")
mutants.target: a crash ending on a hint: the note is the error line

mutants.name: a check that ran gets a note too
mutants.target: control: a check that ran carries no note
